    <title>v2.9.7</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>2.9.7 / 2026.09.16</h3>

<li>fix(cli): don't duplicate passthrough args for deno deploy/sandbox (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5279316267" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36722" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36722/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36722">#36722</a>)</li>
<li>fix(cli): generate valid bash completions (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5289348570" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36736" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36736/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36736">#36736</a>)</li>
<li>fix(cli): preserve double dash before the entrypoint (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5451249448" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36835" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36835/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36835">#36835</a>)</li>
<li>fix(cli): restore optional-value semantics for deno bundle --sourcemap<br>
(<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5279317782" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36723" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36723/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36723">#36723</a>)</li>
<li>fix(completions): keep the dash on short flags in zsh completions (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5276946537" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36720" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36720/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36720">#36720</a>)</li>
<li>fix(desktop): complete deferred window close and fix NAPI symbol export on<br>
Linux (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5276922313" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36718" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36718/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36718">#36718</a>)</li>
<li>fix(ext/http): extract traceparent from Deno.serve regardless of header name<br>
case (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5452216955" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36840" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36840/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36840">#36840</a>)</li>

(<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5130045131" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36553" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36553/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36553">#36553</a>)</li>

    <title>v2.9.6</title>
    <content type="html"><h3>2.9.6 / 2026.08.27</h3>
<ul>
<li>feat(compressible): add support for 'text/x-component' content type (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5080090429" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36450" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36450/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36450">#36450</a>)</li>
<li>feat(desktop): clipboard api (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4802196373" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/35750" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/35750/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/35750">#35750</a>)</li>
<li>feat(desktop): support checked, icon, and tooltip on menu items (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5213545869" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36649" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36649/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36649">#36649</a>)</li>
<li>fix(bundle): isolate esbuild downloads from workspace registries (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5084765005" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36467" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36467/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36467">#36467</a>)</li>
<li>fix(cache): combine duplicate headers for Vary matching (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5085476298" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36476" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36476/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36476">#36476</a>)</li>
<li>fix(cli_parser): remove orphaned sync-types parser</li>
<li>fix(core): cap adaptive buffer initial allocations (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5075870672" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36432" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36432/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36432">#36432</a>)</li>
<li>fix(core): make Unix pipe fd ownership explicit (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5014572775" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36353" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36353/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36353">#36353</a>)</li>
<li>fix(core): make user timer waker state thread-safe (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5094757488" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36495" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36495/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36495">#36495</a>)</li>
<li>fix(coverage): compare a range against a line in V8's units (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5173703061" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36613" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36613/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36613">#36613</a>)</li>
<li>fix(crypto): preserve RSA-OAEP label bytes (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5077114730" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36441" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36441/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36441">#36441</a>)</li>
<li>fix(desktop): keep dots in the app name when resolving the runtime library<br>
(<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="4873757704" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36006" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36006/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36006">#36006</a>)</li>
<li>fix(desktop): keep the macOS bundle signature valid unless an update is<br>
applied (<a class="issue-link js-issue-link" data-error-text="Failed to load title" data-id="5140780470" data-permission-text="Title is private" data-url="https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/36574" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/denoland/deno/pull/36574/hovercard" href="https://github.com/denoland/deno/pull/36574">#36574</a>)</li>
